dropHint: Drop invoices here (PDF or image), or ask a question.
seed3: What is ready to approve, and for how much?
askPlaceholder: Ask about a run, a supplier, or a purchase order…
approveSub: Parked as drafts. Reversible. Nothing is paid.
markedOverride: Marked for approval. It will be sent to SAP with the rest when you approve the batch, and SAP may still refuse it.
markedReject: Marked as rejected. It will not be sent to SAP, and the file moves to the rejected archive.
postingRefused: SAP refused this invoice. It passed every check we can run, and was still turned down at the write.
postingRefusedImpact: Nothing was written for this one. The file stays in the upload bucket, so it can be retried once the cause is fixed. The rest of the batch is unaffected.
filedError: Posted, but the file could not be archived
tooMany: Up to {max} documents at a time.
uploadFailed: The documents could not be uploaded.
allDuplicates: Every document you dropped is one already read in this session. Nothing to check.
duplicatesSkipped: {count} identical to a document already read — skipped, not uploaded.
askUse: Invoice {invoice} should be re-issued against purchase order {po}. Does that order actually match it on supplier, material, quantity and price, and what would still need checking?
askSend: Draft a short note to the buyer about invoice {invoice}: what is wrong, what it blocks, and what you need from them.
askWhy: Why was invoice {invoice} blocked? Explain it for someone who does not use SAP.
parkErrorHeadline: Passed every check, but SAP did not confirm the write. Nothing was posted for payment - retry, or send to buyer.
emptyTitle: Every supplier invoice checked against live SAP before a person approves it.
emptyBody: Drop invoice PDFs or photos into the bar above, or load the sample batch to watch a full run end to end.
emptyStep1: Reads each document and pulls out the supplier, purchase order, quantities and amounts.
emptyStep2: Runs 16 checks against live S/4HANA — 13 arithmetic and lookup, 3 judged by the model.
emptyStep3: Stops at one approval. Approving parks drafts in SAP. Nothing is ever paid automatically.
